title: Naturally Smoky Japanese Cottage Cheese Katsudon
description: A smoky and romantic Japanese dish featuring cottage cheese and ssam-wrap, perfect for a unique dinner experience. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is a twist on the classic katsudon.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add sesame oil.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced smoked salmon and cook for 2 minutes until heated through.
In a large bowl, mix together the cottage cheese, soy sauce, and chopped green onion.
Add the cooked salmon mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Layout the ssam wrap sheets on a wooden board.
Spoon the cottage cheese and salmon mixture onto the center of each ssam wrap sheet.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up to form a tight cylinder.
